Data Engineer Python + PySpark Skill: Data Engineer – Python + PySpark
 Job Requisition No.: 1487899
 Experience: 3–8 Years
 Location: PAN India
 Role: Data Engineer – PySpark + AWS Glue 
 Job Description We are looking for an experienced Data Engineer with strong hands-on expertise in Python, PySpark, AWS Glue, Snowflake, AWS services, and SQL . The candidate will be responsible for developing and optimizing scalable data pipelines, ETL/ELT workflows, and cloud-based data solutions. Key Responsibilities Design, develop, and maintain scalable data pipelines using Python and PySpark. Build and manage ETL/ELT workflows using AWS Glue. Work with Snowflake for data warehousing and data processing. Develop and optimize data solutions using AWS S3, Lambda, and CloudWatch . Write efficient and optimized SQL queries for data extraction, transformation, and analysis. Perform data pipeline and application performance tuning . Implement data integration solutions across multiple data sources and platforms. Ensure data quality, reliability, scalability, and availability of data pipelines. Troubleshoot and resolve data pipeline and production issues. Collaborate with data engineers, architects, analysts, and other stakeholders to deliver robust data solutions. Required Skills 3–8 years of experience in Data Engineering. Strong hands-on experience with:
 Python PySpark AWS Glue Snowflake AWS S3 AWS Lambda AWS CloudWatch SQL Strong understanding of:
 ETL / ELT Data Warehousing Data Pipelines Data Integration Performance Tuning Cloud Data Platforms Good to Have Exposure to AI/ML or GenAI solutions . Knowledge of Oracle Fusion Cloud / Oracle Applications . Experience working with large-scale data processing and cloud-native data engineering solutions. Ideal Candidate The ideal candidate should have strong practical experience in Python + PySpark + AWS Glue , along with good knowledge of Snowflake and AWS cloud services . Strong problem-solving, debugging, and communication skills are expected. Immediate/short notice candidates are preferred.

Key Skills: Pyspark,Python,aws,Data,Data Engineering
